correctness.rationale: Sharp fractional isoperimetry gives \(P_s(E_i)>=P_s(B)\), and two disjoint ball translates attain equality, so \(m_s=2P_s(B)\) for every \(s\). The standard local limit gives the asymptotic. Independent arithmetic gives \(T=9.6719517241\), \(S_0=10.1549129756\), \(C_0=9.1394216781\), with gaps \(0.48296\) and \(0.53253\).
